_what: The owner's answers to the decision brief (docs/decisions/brief.json), as recorded on its page (answers/<id> in the page's database) on 2026-09-25: five picked there, the rest accepted as recommended in one instruction. `build` is where the answer's backend change stands: none (the build already does it), to do, done, or outside (it needs something this repository cannot reach). tools/build_audit.py reads it: a decided item is no longer the owner's, and waits on the build, then on the document. `left`, where present, names the part of a built answer still to build here; `outside`, the part that needs what this repository cannot reach (a store console, the deployment); `client`, what the client still has to do.

F33.left: the re-measure of §5.2's ward budget with the Glare at the alarm's reach, which waits on F52: under Whispers that reach is the whole realm

F37.client: daily goals and ruins, when they are built: one goal a day needs no heist, its pages to the law the player marked

F38.client: an adopt prompt for a found stray, at the next birth's price

F41.left: §22.4's monthly gift limit and parental approval rules for minors, for which the document gives no number: a gift a minor buys is held by their §20.2 cap, and one a minor receives is not limited
F41.client: the shop screen: each item's money price, and the gift flow
F41.outside: each item as a product in App Store Connect and the Play Console, gifts as consumables

G24.left: the kind a wall or hedge regrows as: Crystal growth's clear crystal (walks blocked, sight not), and which kind wins when Bloom and Crystal growth both stand, which the answer does not say; the sim regrows hedges only, as hedges

F43.client: the deletion screen's “withdraw my islands too” (D70)

F50.outside: the bucket the journal lives in, and who may write to it; an export job with a 30-day expiry, if exports are built

G39.outside: the web OAuth client id and the link from the store listing

F46.client: the target card shows laws, guards and ward counts

G19.client: the builder locks the Heart at realm level 3

G32.how: accepted as recommended, and built as the brief's conflict with F41 C resolves it: with no balance to go negative, a refund revokes the product's entitlement
G32.outside: the notification URL set in App Store Connect

G29.client: send session_start and session_end, and ask the survey when GET /v1/survey says it is the player's

G38.outside: purging the edge cache of an under-13 player's erased bundles and lists: a shorter cache life does not recall copies already cached

G35.client: the friends' feed screen, which names a friend as the device knows them

G34.client: report the device's IANA time zone with the push token and on every launch; the reminder picker offers no time inside the night

G41.how: the owner's words: the rule online and recommended heavily to the player, the exception offline
